fields.label: Name
fields.description: What you will call it in the switcher. Anything memorable — 'hetzner-prod', 'new box'.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Where its console lives, e.g. https://server2.example.com. Include the scheme; the port too if it is not 443.

fields.label: This Is The Local Server
fields.description: Tick for the machine you are on. It is listed so the switcher can offer a way back, and it is never called over the network.

fields.label: Verify TLS
fields.description: Leave on. Turn it off ONLY for a server that has no certificate yet — which is common on one you have just provisioned, and is exactly when you would be moving sites onto it. An unverified connection can be read and altered in transit, and this one carries backups.

fields.label: Reported Hostname
fields.description: What the machine calls itself. A mismatch with the name you gave it is worth a second look.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: From the remote's User record — the api_key of a System Manager there. Not a secret on its own; the secret below is.

fields.label: API Secret
fields.description: Stored encrypted and never returned to the browser. It grants everything this app can do on that machine, so give it its own user rather than reusing a person's.
